products.name: Microsoft Purview Adoption Program — Commercial
products.short_description: Drive real adoption, not just config in Microsoft Purview — an adoption program: champions, comms, and behavior change for labels/DLP/compliance, piloted and validated. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Drive real adoption, not just config in Microsoft Purview

Configured controls fail without adoption. Left unaddressed, this is a compliance gap and a data-risk exposure. This solution delivers it end to end in Microsoft Purview: an adoption program: champions, comms, and behavior change for labels/DLP/compliance — configured, piloted in simulation/test where applicable, validated, and operable — so the capability is in place and defensible.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — what this delivers, how it works in Purview, and the Assess→Design→Configure→Pilot(simulate)→Validate→Expand model.
  • Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (Purview/compliance licensing, least-privilege roles, in-scope data, stakeholders).
  • Implementation Guide — configure an adoption program: champions, comms, and behavior change for labels/DLP/compliance; pilot in simulation/test first, validate, then enforce/expand — each policy/label/object named, with pass/fail gates + rollback.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — Discovery, Configuration/Remediation (simulation/-WhatIf first), Validation, Reporting, and a scope/health helper — Security & Compliance PowerShell / Microsoft Graph (read-only or -WhatIf by default; no credentials in code).
  • Testing/validation gates + Best Practices; regulatory/records/legal determinations deferred to the relevant governance functions.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Drive real adoption, not just config — delivered, validated, and defensible in Microsoft Purview.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • OPSADOPT-Discovery.ps1 — read-only inventory of the Purview ADOPTION SURFACE (published sensitivity labels, label policies + scope, DLP/retention modes) with optional baseline save/compare. Makes no changes
    • OPSADOPT-KpiReport.ps1 — read-only adoption KPI dashboard + WAVE-GATE verdict: composes labeling coverage, DLP override rate, champion coverage, and comms reach from live signal plus a comms-reach CSV, and reports each KPI against its threshold. Makes no changes
    • OPSADOPT-Remediation.ps1 — change-controlled adoption ring helper: EXPANDS the adoption ring by the next wave (AddWave) or rolls a wave back (RemoveWave) via Microsoft Graph group membership. -WhatIf by DEFAULT; writes only with -Commit
    • OPSADOPT-Report.ps1 — read-only adoption-signal report: reads the unified audit log for sensitivity-label activity and DLP match/override counts, optionally scoped to an adoption ring. Makes no changes
    • OPSADOPT-Validation.ps1 — read-only champion & ring COVERAGE diff: compares an expected champions roster (and intended wave membership) against actual Microsoft Graph champions-group and ring-group membership. Makes no changes

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
